source: P2 final index-C0vYNo8f.js, Chrome SwiftShader, 1280x800 DPR1
sampling: sRGB centre-column pixels, isolated runtime visibility/shader variants; not linear radiance
findings: Sky-only retains a broad near-white lower sky in clear/overcast eye-height scenes; no-clouds and no-fog are nearly identical near the center horizon.
No-context removes the straight dark green horizon; camera-height-faded flat context creates it.
Removing cloud horizon fade alone exposes vertical strip artifacts and cannot be used as a fix.
Independent fixed FogExp2 color/visibility remains a source of optical inconsistency, even though it is not the dominant white band in the sampled clear center ray.
